pr_body:
Add project settings to easily set the minimum and maximum window size.

Closes: #31303

Related PR that caused crashing: #31367
pr_comments:
@codecustard  Is this still desired? If so, it needs to be rebased on the latest master branch. Also, the above feedback should be addressed.

Otherwise, abandoned pull requests will be closed in the future as announced [here](https://godotengine.org/article/headsup-vulkan-merged-master-branch-unstable).

Certainly the minimum window size aspect of this is still desired.

Given the implementation question around the maximum size, I think it would make sense to split the maximum-window-size related functionality into a separate PR so at least the minimum window size can be enforced.

Being able to shrink the window in such a way that UI controls are cut-off looks...unpolished IMO. :)
This PR is abandoned, closing. Anyone is welcome to salvage this, however, note that there is overlap with #37260.

issue_context.title: Minimal and maximal window size in project settings
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please search existing issues for potential duplicates before filing yours:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues?q=is%3Aissue
-->

**Godot version:** 3.1.1
<!-- Specify commit hash if non-official. -->

**Issue description:**
Hey guys,
so I was wondering why there isn't an option for the minimal and the maximal window size in the  project settings.

I mean it's possible to solve this with a gdscript but I believe it would be a nice feature.

Regards
BaseCrusher
comments:
The [ability to set a minimum/maximum window size](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/29752) was merged in the `master` branch in June, which means it isn't available in 3.1.1. It will be available in 3.2 though :slightly_smiling_face:

That said, I can confirm there are currently no project settings to set it easily.

Oh good to know.
Thx for the reply. :)
@akien-mga This issue is still valid, as there are no project settings to set a minimum/maximum window size *specific to a project*.
This should be reopened as #31367 was reverted in #31435.
Seems like the most recent related PR is: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/31990

I just ran into this wanting to set a minimum size for my window. Since it's usually a static property it feels like it should be set along with the other project window settings. It feels kind of hacky to set it in a script with `DisplayServer.window_set_min_size()` when the game loads. 

Unfortunately it seems like the pull request referenced above has been abandoned, but it feels like this should not be too big a change and I'd love to see this added to 4.x

Yep, I also feel like this would be a cool feature for someone who's developing software and not games. Considering that it's not much of a big deal when it comes to the project settings, and it could even be added to the "advanced" project settings, I see no reason not to add this feature.
Closing in favor of https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/7586, as feature proposals are now tracked in the Godot proposals repository.

review_comments: If 0, there should not be a max window size IMO.
